name: Remi Novotný
role: Retired Corporate Wars veteran, pension-dependent resident and informal neighborhood watchman
location: The Shelf — Block 14, Unit 7, near the Ferrogate Transit overpass, near Ashland and Division
description:
Remi Novotný is a big man who used to be bigger. He carries the memory of his former mass in the way he takes up space — a wide-legged stance, arms that hang a little away from his sides, a way of turning his whole torso instead of just his head that comes from decades of wearing combat plating. His dark brown skin is mapped with synthetic-graft patches along his neck and left arm where the original was burned away in the Menomonee Gulch campaign; the grafts are slightly lighter and have a different texture, which he doesn't bother to hide. His right eye is military-grade steel-grey augmetic, a stark contrast to his warm brown left. He keeps his head shaved and his grey-streaked beard precisely trimmed — two things he can still control.

Rodrigo served fourteen years in Arcturus Corporation's private military arm before being discharged when a nerve-suppression injury to his left leg made him operationally unviable. His pension is a Tier 1.5 embarrassment — enough to keep the unit heated, barely. He spends most of his days on the block: watching who comes and goes, intervening in disputes with the particular authority of a man who has seen what disputes can become, and maintaining an informal truce between three rival youth crews that he negotiates with the patience of a man who has nothing left to prove. He doesn't miss combat. He misses the clarity of knowing exactly who he was supposed to protect.

core_fears: Becoming useless — truly, physically unable to protect anyone
That the war he fought was entirely without meaning and the kids in his crew are going to repeat it
core_desires: To see one generation on this block escape the cycle
To feel like the years he gave to Arcturus bought something real
coping_mechanisms: Channeling anxiety into practical action for others
Deliberate humor about his own limitations
blind_spots: Attributes too much of what he survived to personal strength rather than luck
Has difficulty recognizing when he's intimidating people who need help instead of structure
psychology.secret: During the Menomonee Gulch campaign, he was ordered to clear a civilian shelter that Arcturus command had designated a hostile position. He didn't. He pulled his unit back and filed a falsified report. Seven of his soldiers were court-martialed for the mission failure. He was not — he was the one who wrote the report. Two of those soldiers are dead. One lives two blocks away on The Shelf and has never spoken to him since.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and economical — military habit; uses neighborhood slang with younger residents to signal solidarity, drops it completely when something serious is happening
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and even, with significant pauses; raises his voice rarely and to devastating effect
verbal_tics: A long exhale before he says something difficult
example_lines: 'I'm not going to tell you what to do. I'm going to tell you what happens, and then you can decide.'
'Copy that. Now tell me what you actually need, not what you think I want to hear.'

story_hooks: The veteran who lives two blocks away has started talking — specifically to a journalist doing a piece on Arcturus corporate war crimes, and Rodrigo's falsified report is the thread that unravels everything
One of the youth crew members he's been mentoring has been recruited by a corponation subsidiary, and Rodrigo recognizes the recruitment pipeline for exactly what it is
narrative_function: Community anchor and low-key quest giver; knows everyone on The Shelf and most of the tensions beneath the surface. Can connect players to Shelf residents, provide military history of the Corporate Wars from the grunt's perspective, or serve as a morally weighted obstacle when the neighborhood's safety conflicts with outside agendas.
augmentations: Military-grade right-eye augmetic (Arcturus model, unsupported since discharge — runs on patched firmware); synthetic skin grafts (burn replacement, left arm and neck); nerve-suppression damage in left leg (unaugmented, managed with medication he can't always afford). No geneware.
daily_life: Up before dawn to walk the block perimeter — old habit. Morning coffee at the corner vendor with whoever's awake. Afternoons mediating disputes or sitting in on the veterans' mutual aid meetings. Evenings usually involve someone's kid coming to him with a problem they can't take to anyone official.
affiliation: Arcturus Corporation (discharged, pension); Meridian Veterans Mutual Aid Society; The Shelf informal community watch

decision_rules: Don't involve official channels unless there's no other option
Take responsibility for outcomes, even bad ones
escalation_ladder: Decisive physical intervention if someone is going to get hurt

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing and non-committal — watches before engaging, but not unfriendly once he's decided someone is worth talking to
interpersonal_modes.friends: Gruff affection, practical support, shows up without being asked

stress_responses.high: Controlled, cold, and extremely effective — the old professional surfaces

contradictions: Preaches accountability but has never confessed his biggest failure
Distrusts corporations absolutely while living off corporate pension bureaucracy
habits: Checks all exits when entering a room
Keeps a small battered photograph of his former unit in his jacket — never looks at it, never throws it away
Offers food before conversation when someone comes to him with a problem
breaking_points: Watching someone be made to feel worthless for asking for help
Any corponation recruiter operating openly on his block

timeline.event: Menomonee Gulch campaign — the incident with the civilian shelter
Discharged after nerve-suppression injury, Arcturus pension assigned
Became de facto mediator for Block 14 disputes
Helped found Meridian Veterans Mutual Aid Society

physical_description.heritage: Remi carries the genetic signature of the Ubiquitous Diaspora — a balanced blend of East Asian (28.4%), Sub-Saharan African (21.5%), Central Asian (21.5%), and Eastern European (21.3%) ancestry, with Middle Eastern (7.3%) influence. This multi-continental mix produces a distinctive phenotype: warm deep brown skin with complex undertones that shift across his face and body. Golden warmth from Sub-Saharan and Central Asian genes mingles with cooler undertones from Eastern European heritage, while East Asian ancestry contributes to refined facial geometry — high defined cheekbones and a structured jaw. The result is a face that belongs equally to no single continental origin and entirely to the cosmopolitan future.
physical_description.build: Heavy-framed, formerly muscular, now carrying softness and age in the belly and chest. Still broad across shoulders but with visible loss of mass and definition — the kind of decline that comes from fourteen years of peak conditioning followed by slow atrophy.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with grey at temples and throughout
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: military-grade steel-grey augmetic (unflinching, constant luminescence). Left eye: warm brown, naturally aged with crow's feet.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones from blended Sub-Saharan, Central Asian, and East Asian ancestry, displaying uneven texture — natural warm-toned skin contrasted by lighter synthetic-graft patches that interrupt the natural golden warmth of his complexion.
physical_description.complexion: Heavily lined face weathered by time and trauma, with a well-maintained grey beard trimmed close. Scars visible at the jawline and temple. The underlying bone structure shows refined East Asian influence in high cheekbones and angular jaw definition, softened by fuller lips characteristic of Sub-Saharan heritage and broader facial proportions reflecting Central Asian ancestry. Synthetic-graft skin on left arm and neck is noticeably smoother and lacks the golden-brown warmth of his natural melanin-rich skin, with faint seam-texture visible under direct light. The contrast between natural deep brown skin and pale synthetic grafts creates a stark visual narrative of replacement and survival.
distinguishing_marks: Extensive burn-scar tissue on left arm from wrist to shoulder, replaced with synthetic grafts that are slightly discolored and have different tactile texture
Synthetic-graft coverage on left side of neck extending from collarbone to jawline, visible as a paler band with subtle seaming
Deep linear scar along right temple, partially obscured by head shape
Faded Arcturus corporate tattoo (stylized A in geometric form) on inner right forearm, worn and slightly faded
Burn marks and scar tissue visible where synthetic grafts meet natural skin, creating visible borderlines
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye is unmistakably prosthetic — a steel-grey military-grade optic with faint red circuitry visible at the iris. It does not move in sync with his left eye and emits a faint subsonic hum when scanning. Extensive synthetic-graft patches on left arm and neck are visible as slightly discolored, texturally distinct skin replacements. Walks with a slight leftward lean and favors his right side — evidence of nerve damage in left leg.
physical_description.posture_movement: Wide-legged stance even when standing still. Turns his entire torso rather than just his head — old habit from combat plating. Movements are measured and deliberate, economical. Left leg has a subtle drag at the end of his stride. Sits with his back against walls. Eyes (particularly the augmetic) scan environments methodically. Handshakes are firm but controlled.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian. Well-worn Arcturus Corporation legacy jacket (charcoal synth-leather, faded patches, visible Φ550 price tag from a decade ago still sewn inside). Plain grey thermal underlayer, dark cargo pants with functional pockets and reinforced seams. Boots are military surplus, maintained meticulously. No jewelry. A faded cloth veteran's badge pinned to jacket collar. Clothes are clean and functional but show age — not poor, but not well-maintained by choice. The precision of his grooming contrasts sharply with the wear of his clothing.
